photos.c: Bill Aylett of Blackheath was a noted contemporary of Bob Taylor. They are seen here during two half-mile races in 1953. LEFT: Taylor (10) is dogged by Aylett (4) in the L.C.C. Champs. The Blackheath man pipped Bob for the title in 1:55.6.
RIGHT:Bob gains his revenge in the Surrey v. Middx. v. Kent match, where he beats Aylett (Kent) and Martin (Surrey) in 1:58.9.
